name: Miina -Atashi no Namae-
original_name: 深衣奈-アタシノナマエ-
source:
Cabaret Girl Mina has a secret she can't tell anyone...

...she's really a man!

But when Hostess No. 1 Sari invites Mina to her room...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032954.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
歌舞伎女孩美奈有一个不能告诉任何人的秘密……

……其实她是男人！

但当头牌女公关纱莉邀请美奈到自己的房间时……

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032954.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
